rootSection:
## Auth extension

Installed by `bun run shibumi add auth`; full guide in `agents/auth.md`.

- Routes under `/auth` (register, login, login-link, verify, logout, me) live in `src/routes/auth.ts`; core logic and `requireAuth`/`optionalAuth` middleware in `src/lib/auth.ts`.
- Sessions: HttpOnly Secure cookie; the database stores sha256 token hashes in `sessions`, never tokens.
- Tables `users`, `sessions`, `login_tokens` come from the installed migration; Drizzle schema in `src/db/schema-auth.ts`.
- Login-link delivery is a seam (`deliverLoginLink`): development logs the URL, production throws until wired to the email extension (snippet in agents/auth.md).
- Honeypot: the optional `website` field on register/login/login-link marks bots; non-empty values get plausible responses with no work done.
- Removal deletes code only; tables stay. Manual drop statements are in agents/auth.md.
removeNote: Tables users, sessions, and login_tokens stay in app.db wherever the migration already ran. Drop them manually if unwanted: DROP TABLE login_tokens; DROP TABLE sessions; DROP TABLE users;
